text: What were the three slowest-response wards in 2025? Use sql.

args.query: SELECT IncGeo_WardName AS ward, AVG(FirstPumpArriving_AttendanceTime) AS avg_response_seconds FROM incidents WHERE CalYear = 2025 GROUP BY IncGeo_WardName ORDER BY avg_response_seconds DESC LIMIT 3;

text: The three slowest-response wards in 2025 were DARWIN (540.2 s), CHESSINGTON SOUTH & MALDEN RUSHETT (530.5 s), and RIDGEWAY (528.9 s).
